components.name: Spore Cannon
components.blurb: Grown, not built: a ringed tube that breathes out a cloud and takes its breath from the room. The cloud knows where it is going.
components.quirk: Spores: the room it hits loses air (6% of full a second for 8 s). It eats some of the air in its own room too (3% of full per shot); Sporelings' spores put it back. Weak direct damage.

components.name: Rot Pod
components.blurb: A violet pod on a claw, ripe on the shelf and slightly sorry. It does not explode. It settles in.
components.quirk: Acid: eats the hit cell for 8 s (0.75 a second) and creeps on to neighbouring walls and parts (30% a tick, up to 12 cells at once). The pods grow on the room's air: 2% of full per shot. Spends missiles.

components.name: Pollen Turret
components.blurb: Petals open, grains drift, and the crew on the far side of the wall decide it's a good moment to sit down.
components.quirk: Sleep: the crew in the room it hits are stunned for 3 s. Almost no damage, and 5% of its own room's air goes with each shot; Sporelings breathe it back.

components.name: Bloom Reactor
components.blurb: Warm and cheap, a flower round an amber heart. It drinks the air in the room. The Sporelings hum a little louder to make up the difference.
components.quirk: +3 power over a Reactor Mk1 and cheap to build, but it eats the air of its room. Sporeling auras put air back, a plain crew gasps.

components.name: Mycelium Shield
components.blurb: A web of threads that knits back faster than it frays, and breathes a little of the room to do it.
components.quirk: Layers come back 1.5x faster (1.33 s instead of 2 s), but the shield breathes the room's air (1.5% a second). Sporeling auras put air back.

components.name: Garden Bay
components.blurb: Planter, gills and a small hopeful sprout. Twice the air of a plain scrubber. Do not leave it near the welding.
components.quirk: Makes twice the air of an Oxygen Generator (1.2 against 0.6) in half the footprint, but it catches fire easily (0.015 a second in its room).
